description: This file defines a module for rendering ApexCharts charts, including functions for aligning data series categories, building charts with specific options, and generating custom tooltips. It also includes color configuration and theme detection.

methods.name: align_categories
methods.description: Aligns series data points by their x-axis categories, filling missing values with zeros, and sorts categories.

methods.name: build_sqlpage_chart
methods.description: Builds and renders a chart inside a given HTML element based on embedded data.

methods.name: bubbleTooltip
methods.description: Generates custom tooltip HTML for bubble and scatter chart points.
